semantic_boundary.r26_digest_behavior: Consumes the stored r25_sha256 text as a digest preimage component; no recursive R25 semantic digest call is part of the recovered R26 digest definition.
semantic_boundary.r26_verifier_behavior: Requires R25 lineage/provenance checks to be mapped natively before full R26 lineage success can be claimed.
semantic_boundary.historical_r25_receipt_role: Provenance/linkage witness only; historical 68/68 PASS is not a native rerun and does not become native qualification credit.

native_mapping_requirements: Map every R26 verifier dependency on R25 to an explicit native input/check rather than invoking historical Python.
Freeze exact policy and manifest parsing semantics used by the native lineage check.
Define failure/refusal behavior for missing, altered, ambiguous, malformed, or mismatched R25 inputs.
Pair each accepted-path check with negative fixtures that cannot be satisfied by merely replaying historical receipt text.
Keep historical R25 semantic digest and 68/68 receipt as comparison/provenance witnesses only.
Require independent review before native R25 mapping can contribute to R26/R27 continuity.
